verses.1: For this reason I, Paul, the prisoner of Christ Jesus, am serving you Gentiles—
verses.2: if indeed you have heard of the administration of God’s grace that was given to me for you,
verses.3: for it was revealed to me in a vision the mystery, as I briefly wrote before,
verses.4: which you can discern as you read and understand my insight into the mystery of Christ,
verses.5: a mystery not made known to previous generations of human beings, but now revealed to God’s holy apostles and prophets in the Spirit—
verses.6: that the Gentiles are fellow heirs, and fellow members, and fellow participants of the promise in Christ Jesus through the gospel,
verses.7: of which I became a servant according to the gift of God’s grace given to me by the power of His energy—
verses.8: to me, the least of all God’s holy ones, this grace was given—to proclaim to the Gentiles the insearchable riches of Christ,
verses.9: and to make known to all what is the administration of the mystery that has been hidden for ages in God, who created all things,
verses.10: so that now the manifold wisdom of God might be made known to the rulers and authorities in the heavenly realms through the church,
verses.11: according to His eternal purpose, which He set forth in Christ Jesus our Lord,
verses.12: in whom we have boldness and access with confidence through faith in Him.
verses.13: Therefore I urge you not to be discouraged by my sufferings for you, which are your glory.
verses.14: For this reason I kneel before the Father,
verses.15: from whom every fatherly name in heaven and on earth is named,
verses.16: that He may grant you, according to the riches of His glory, to be strengthened with power through His Spirit in the inner man,
verses.17: that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith, rooted and grounded in love,
verses.18: so that you may be able to comprehend with all the holy ones what is the breadth and length and height and depth,
verses.19: and to know the love of Christ that surpasses knowledge, so that you may be filled to all the fullness of God.
verses.20: Now to Him who is able to do exceeding abundantly beyond all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,
verses.21: to Him be glory in the church and in Christ Jesus throughout all generations forever and ever. Amen.

notes:
Notes
- v. 9: "φωτίσαι πάντας τίς ἡ οἰκονομία" is best rendered as "to make known to all what is the administration"—a complex construction where "πάντας" is dative, meaning "to all."
- v. 18: "καταλαβέσθαι σὺν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἁγίοις τί τὸ πλάτος καὶ μῆκος καὶ ὕψος καὶ βάθος" is a poetic, metaphorical structure. The phrase is best translated as "to comprehend... what is the breadth and length and height and depth," without adding interpretive adjectives like "infinite" or "unfathomable."
